metadata.question: Does the land surface temperature in Thailand increase in April 2016 compared to April 2001-2010 average?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS/061/MOD11A1 (Daily LST) - available from 2000 - Date: April 2016 vs April 2001-2010 (10 years average) - Location: Thailand (need to define geometry) 2. Masking strategy: - LST data has QA bands, should mask clouds and poor quality pixels - Use QC_Day band for quality filtering 3. Logic: - Valid Zero: LST cannot be zero or negative in realistic scenarios (Kelvin scale). If result is unrealistic, it's C3. - Need to check: collection size, pixel counts after masking, and valid LST values - Compare 2016 April mean vs 2001-2010 April mean - If 2016 > baseline average → A (Yes), else → B (No) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions thailand = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[97.3, 5.6], [105.6, 5.6], [105.6, 20.5], [97.3, 20.5], [97.3, 5.6]] ]) # 2. Data Acquisition # Baseline period: April 2001-2010 baseline_col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') \ .filterBounds(thailand) \ .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2001, 2010, 'year')) \ .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(4, 4, 'month')) \ .select('LST_Day_1km') # Target period: April 2016 target_col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') \ .filterBounds(thailand) \ .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2016, 2016, 'year')) \ .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(4, 4, 'month')) \ .select('LST_Day_1km') baseline_size = baseline_col.size().getInfo() target_size = target_col.size().getInfo() print(f"Baseline (2001-2010 April) images: {baseline_size}") print(f"Target (2016 April) images: {target_size}") if baseline_size == 0 or target_size == 0: print("Missing data for one or both periods.") print("C1") else: # 3. Processing - Create mean composites baseline_mean = baseline_col.mean() target_mean = target_col.mean() # 4. Calculate regional statistics baseline_stats = baseline_mean.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True), geometry=thailand, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ) target_stats = target_mean.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True), geometry=thailand, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ) baseline_lst = baseline_stats.get('LST_Day_1km_mean').getInfo() baseline_count = baseline_stats.get('LST_Day_1km_count').getInfo() target_lst = target_stats.get('LST_Day_1km_mean').getInfo() target_count = target_stats.get('LST_Day_1km_count').getInfo() print(f"Baseline LST (Kelvin): {baseline_lst}, Pixels: {baseline_count}") print(f"Target LST (Kelvin): {target_lst}, Pixels: {target_count}") # 5. Validation & Final Answer if baseline_count == 0 or target_count == 0: print("No valid pixels after processing.") print("C2") elif baseline_lst is None or target_lst is None or baseline_lst < 200 or target_lst < 200 or baseline_lst > 400 or target_lst > 400: print("Invalid LST values detected.") print("C3") else: # Convert to Celsius for interpretation baseline_c = baseline_lst * 0.02 - 273.15 target_c = target_lst * 0.02 - 273.15 diff = target_c - baseline_c print(f"Baseline LST: {baseline_c:.2f}C") print(f"2016 April LST: {target_c:.2f}C") print(f"Difference: {diff:.2f}C") if target_c > baseline_c: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
thailand = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[97.3, 5.6], [105.6, 5.6], [105.6, 20.5], [97.3, 20.5], [97.3, 5.6]]
])

# 2. Data Acquisition
# Baseline period: April 2001-2010
baseline_col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') \
    .filterBounds(thailand) \
    .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2001, 2010, 'year')) \
    .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(4, 4, 'month')) \
    .select('LST_Day_1km')

# Target period: April 2016
target_col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') \
    .filterBounds(thailand) \
    .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2016, 2016, 'year')) \
    .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(4, 4, 'month')) \
    .select('LST_Day_1km')

baseline_size = baseline_col.size().getInfo()
target_size = target_col.size().getInfo()

print(f"Baseline (2001-2010 April) images: {baseline_size}")
print(f"Target (2016 April) images: {target_size}")

if baseline_size == 0 or target_size == 0:
    print("Missing data for one or both periods.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - Create mean composites
    baseline_mean = baseline_col.mean()
    target_mean = target_col.mean()
    
    # 4. Calculate regional statistics
    baseline_stats = baseline_mean.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
        geometry=thailand,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    target_stats = target_mean.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
        geometry=thailand,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    baseline_lst = baseline_stats.get('LST_Day_1km_mean').getInfo()
    baseline_count = baseline_stats.get('LST_Day_1km_count').getInfo()
    target_lst = target_stats.get('LST_Day_1km_mean').getInfo()
    target_count = target_stats.get('LST_Day_1km_count').getInfo()
    
    print(f"Baseline LST (Kelvin): {baseline_lst}, Pixels: {baseline_count}")
    print(f"Target LST (Kelvin): {target_lst}, Pixels: {target_count}")
    
    # 5. Validation & Final Answer
    if baseline_count == 0 or target_count == 0:
        print("No valid pixels after processing.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif baseline_lst is None or target_lst is None or baseline_lst < 200 or target_lst < 200 or baseline_lst > 400 or target_lst > 400:
        print("Invalid LST values detected.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        # Convert to Celsius for interpretation
        baseline_c = baseline_lst * 0.02 - 273.15
        target_c = target_lst * 0.02 - 273.15
        diff = target_c - baseline_c
        
        print(f"Baseline LST: {baseline_c:.2f}C")
        print(f"2016 April LST: {target_c:.2f}C")
        print(f"Difference: {diff:.2f}C")
        
        if target_c > baseline_c:
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
